description: Defines complex mathematical functions (exponential, logarithmic, power, trigonometric, hyperbolic) for c10::complex<T> with platform-specific implementations and exports them in c10_complex_math namespace, also making them available in std namespace.

methods.name: exp
methods.description: Computes the exponential of a complex number, platform-specific implementation.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Computes the natural logarithm of a complex number, platform-specific implementation.

methods.name: log10
methods.description: Computes the base-10 logarithm of a complex number, platform-specific implementation.

methods.name: log2
methods.description: Computes the base-2 logarithm of a complex number.

methods.name: sqrt
methods.description: Computes the square root of a complex number, platform-specific implementation.

methods.name: pow
methods.description: Computes the power of complex numbers or complex and real combinations, platform-specific implementation.

methods.name: sin
methods.description: Computes the sine of a complex number.

methods.name: cos
methods.description: Computes the cosine of a complex number.

methods.name: tan
methods.description: Computes the tangent of a complex number.

methods.name: asin
methods.description: Computes the arcsine of a complex number.

methods.name: acos
methods.description: Computes the arccosine of a complex number.

methods.name: atan
methods.description: Computes the arctangent of a complex number.

methods.name: sinh
methods.description: Computes the hyperbolic sine of a complex number.

methods.name: cosh
methods.description: Computes the hyperbolic cosine of a complex number.

methods.name: tanh
methods.description: Computes the hyperbolic tangent of a complex number.

methods.name: asinh
methods.description: Computes the inverse hyperbolic sine of a complex number.

methods.name: acosh
methods.description: Computes the inverse hyperbolic cosine of a complex number.

methods.name: atanh
methods.description: Computes the inverse hyperbolic tangent of a complex number.

methods.name: log1p
methods.description: Computes log(1 + z) for a complex number with special handling for accuracy.

methods.name: expm1
methods.description: Computes exp(z) - 1 for a complex number with platform-specific implementation.
